title: El encuentro
goal: Read how first contact with the Taíno turned from peaceful exchange to forced labor and demographic collapse within a generation.
grammar: Secuencia y contraste: mientras, cuando, al principio, después

items: Describe how the first encounter with the Taíno began peacefully and then changed.
Explain what the encomienda was officially, and what it was in practice.
Explain what caused the sharpest population decline among the Taíno.
Describe how the Taíno lived (conucos, bohíos, caneyes) before the Spanish demanded gold.
Use connectors like 'al principio / sin embargo' and 'mientras' to order and contrast events.
